name: Globe International Carriers Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2010, Globe International 
 Carriers Ltd. is an end-to-end transportation 
 and logistic service provider[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview[1]
Company is a cargo transportation and logistic solution provider in India. It offers services for Full truckload consignments and provides transit of material across national and international borders using multimode solutions.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 38.3% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 5.29 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 7.40% over last 3 years.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -10.7%
